messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways, 35 mph on residential streets.
• “No speed limit” zones exist in some rural areas. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• The “no‑seat‑belt” law applies to all vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is prohibited. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Yield to emergency vehicles” when lights are flashing. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• No passing on the left side of a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces, or on sidewalks.
• Parking meters and signs dictate time limits. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Annual safety inspection required for most vehicles. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway).
• Electronic toll collection (TxTag) is mandatory on many. | TxDOT Toll Roads | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Bicyclists must ride on the right side of the road.
• Motorcycles must use the lane and signal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **Penalties & Enforcement** | • Fines vary by offense; points added to driver’s record.
• Repeat offenders face higher penalties and license suspension. | Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT**: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) – for speed limits, road conditions, and construction updates. - **TxDMV**: [https://www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) – for registration, inspection, and licensing. - **Texas DPS**: [https://www.dps.texas.gov](https://www.dps.texas.gov) – for DUI laws, penalties, and driver education. - **Texas Transportation Code**: Available online via the Texas Legislature website or legal databases. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to comply with a particular regulation!
